import Mathlib

theorem_decl:
theorem lean4phys_competition_mechanics_Ch2_Q2_c1_explicit_gap_allowed
  (m : Mass)
  (N Frod Fperp Ff Fc : Force)
  (g : Acceleration)
  (L L1 L2 : Length)
  (omega : AngularVelocity)
  (mu : Dimensionless)
  (alpha : PhysAngle)
  (def_centrifugal_force_magnitude : Fc.val = m.val * (omega.val * omega.val) * (L.val * Real.cos alpha.val))
  (def_limiting_friction_magnitude : Ff.val = mu.val * N.val)
  (h_mi1_centrifugal_magnitude : Fc.val = m.val * (omega.val * omega.val) * (L.val * Real.cos alpha.val))
  (h_mi1_perpendicular_balance : N.val = m.val * g.val * Real.cos alpha.val + Fc.val * Real.sin alpha.val)
  (h_mi1_along_balance_branch_1 : Frod.val = Fc.val * Real.cos alpha.val - m.val * g.val * Real.sin alpha.val - Ff.val)
  (h_mi1_equilibrium_branch_1 : Frod.val = 0)
  (h_mi1_friction_branch_1 : Ff.val = mu.val * N.val)
  (h_mi1_along_balance_branch_2 : Frod.val = Fc.val * Real.cos alpha.val - m.val * g.val * Real.sin alpha.val + Ff.val)
  (h_mi1_equilibrium_branch_2 : Frod.val = 0)
  (h_mi1_friction_branch_2 : Ff.val = mu.val * N.val)
  : L1.val = (g.val * (Real.sin alpha.val - mu.val * Real.cos alpha.val)) / ((omega.val * omega.val) * Real.cos alpha.val * (Real.cos alpha.val + mu.val * Real.sin alpha.val)) ∧
  L2.val = (g.val * (Real.sin alpha.val + mu.val * Real.cos alpha.val)) / ((omega.val * omega.val) * Real.cos alpha.val * (Real.cos alpha.val - mu.val * Real.sin alpha.val))
assumptions: N.val = m.val * g.val * Real.cos alpha.val + Fc.val * Real.sin alpha.val
Frod.val = Fc.val * Real.cos alpha.val - m.val * g.val * Real.sin alpha.val - Ff.val
Frod.val = Fc.val * Real.cos alpha.val - m.val * g.val * Real.sin alpha.val + Ff.val

import Mathlib

theorem_decl:
theorem lean4phys_competition_mechanics_Ch2_Q2_c1_explicit_gap_allowed
  (m : Mass)
  (N1 N2 Fcf1 Fcf2 Fpar1 Fpar2 Fperp1 Fperp2 Fg_par Fg_perp f1 f2 Fnet_par1 Fnet_par2 : Force)
  (g : Acceleration)
  (L L1 L2 : Length)
  (omega : AngularVelocity)
  (positiveAlongRod L1_branch L2_branch : Real)
  (mu : Dimensionless)
  (alpha : PhysAngle)
  (def_horizontal_radius_L1 : Fcf1.val = m.val * (omega.val * omega.val) * (L1.val * Real.cos alpha.val))
  (def_horizontal_radius_L2 : Fcf2.val = m.val * (omega.val * omega.val) * (L2.val * Real.cos alpha.val))
  (def_gravity_component_along_rod : Fg_par.val = m.val * g.val * Real.sin alpha.val)
  (def_gravity_component_perp_rod : Fg_perp.val = m.val * g.val * Real.cos alpha.val)
  (def_centrifugal_component_along_rod_L1 : Fpar1.val = Fcf1.val * Real.cos alpha.val)
  (def_centrifugal_component_along_rod_L2 : Fpar2.val = Fcf2.val * Real.cos alpha.val)
  (def_centrifugal_component_perp_rod_L1 : Fperp1.val = Fcf1.val * Real.sin alpha.val)
  (def_centrifugal_component_perp_rod_L2 : Fperp2.val = Fcf2.val * Real.sin alpha.val)
  (def_limiting_friction_branch_1 : f1.val = mu.val * N1.val)
  (def_limiting_friction_branch_2 : f2.val = mu.val * N2.val)
  (h_mi1_along_rod_balance : Fpar1.val + f1.val = Fg_par.val)
  (h_mi1_perp_balance : N1.val = Fg_perp.val + Fperp1.val)
  (h_mi2_along_rod_balance : Fpar2.val = Fg_par.val + f2.val)
  (h_mi2_perp_balance : N2.val = Fg_perp.val + Fperp2.val)
  (h_mi1_branch_equilibrium_gap : m.val * (omega.val * omega.val) * L1.val * Real.cos alpha.val * Real.cos alpha.val + mu.val * (m.val * g.val * Real.cos alpha.val + m.val * (omega.val * omega.val) * L1.val * Real.sin alpha.val * Real.cos alpha.val) = m.val * g.val * Real.sin alpha.val)
  (h_mi2_branch_equilibrium_gap : m.val * (omega.val * omega.val) * L2.val * Real.cos alpha.val * Real.cos alpha.val = m.val * g.val * Real.sin alpha.val + mu.val * (m.val * g.val * Real.cos alpha.val + m.val * (omega.val * omega.val) * L2.val * Real.sin alpha.val * Real.cos alpha.val))
  : L1.val = (g.val * (Real.sin alpha.val - mu.val * Real.cos alpha.val)) / ((omega.val * omega.val) * Real.cos alpha.val * (Real.cos alpha.val + mu.val * Real.sin alpha.val)) ∧
  L2.val = (g.val * (Real.sin alpha.val + mu.val * Real.cos alpha.val)) / ((omega.val * omega.val) * Real.cos alpha.val * (Real.cos alpha.val - mu.val * Real.sin alpha.val))
assumptions: m.val * (omega.val * omega.val) * L1.val * Real.cos alpha.val * Real.cos alpha.val + mu.val * (m.val * g.val * Real.cos alpha.val + m.val * (omega.val * omega.val) * L1.val * Real.sin alpha.val * Real.cos alpha.val) = m.val * g.val * Real.sin alpha.val

m.val * (omega.val * omega.val) * L2.val * Real.cos alpha.val * Real.cos alpha.val = m.val * g.val * Real.sin alpha.val + mu.val * (m.val * g.val * Real.cos alpha.val + m.val * (omega.val * omega.val) * L2.val * Real.sin alpha.val * Real.cos alpha.val)
plan: Use the explicit-gap branch semantics to tie L1 to the friction-up branch and L2 to the friction-down branch, combine the selected component definitions with the branch-specific along-rod and perpendicular equilibrium balances plus limiting-friction definitions, eliminate N1,f1 and N2,f2 separately, then discharge the remaining algebra obligations to the canonical target formulas.
unsupported_claims: evidence_gap:blocked_1 expected_claim has no single valid verified model predicate binding
evidence_gap:blocked_2 expected_claim has no single valid verified model predicate binding

theorem lean4phys_university_mechanics_Mechanics_76_University_c1_explicit_gap_allowed
  (W F_start_horizontal F_const_horizontal F_pull N f_k F_pull_x F_pull_y Fnet_x Fnet_y : Force)
  (a_x a_y : Acceleration)
  (mu_k : Dimensionless)
  (theta : PhysAngle)
  (given_weight : W.val = 500)
  (given_start_force_horizontal : F_start_horizontal.val = 230)
  (given_const_force_horizontal : F_const_horizontal.val = 200)
  (given_theta : theta.val = 30)
  (given_mu_k : mu_k.val = ((2 : Real) / 5))
  (def_pull_horizontal_component : F_pull_x.val = F_pull.val * Real.cos theta.val)
  (def_pull_vertical_component : F_pull_y.val = F_pull.val * Real.sin theta.val)
  (h_global_sign_convention_x : F_pull_x.val = F_pull.val * Real.cos theta.val)
  (h_global_sign_convention_y : F_pull_y.val = F_pull.val * Real.sin theta.val)
  (h_mi1_accel_x_zero : a_x.val = 0)

theorem lean4phys_university_mechanics_Mechanics_74_University_c1_explicit_gap_allowed
  (W F_start F_const N f_s_max f_k Fnet_y Fnet_x_start Fnet_x_const : Force)
  (mu_s mu_k : Dimensionless)
  (given_weight : W.val = 500)

  (h_global_const_velocity_relation : F_const.val = f_k.val)
  (h_mi1_vertical_balance : N.val - W.val = 0)
  (h_mi2_horizontal_threshold : F_start.val - f_s_max.val = 0)
  (h_mi3_horizontal_balance : F_const.val - f_k.val = 0)
  (h_mi1_expected_claim : N.val = W.val)
  (h_mi2_expected_claim : F_start.val = f_s_max.val)
  (h_mi3_expected_claim : F_const.val = f_k.val)
  : mu_s.val = F_start.val / W.val ∧
  mu_k.val = F_const.val / W.val

theorem lean4phys_competition_mechanics_Ch2_Q1_c1_explicit_gap_allowed
  (M m : Mass)
  (T_heavy T_light : Force)
  (g : Acceleration)
  (n : Real)
  (mu : Dimensionless)
  (theta : PhysAngle)
  (given_M_value : M.val = 1000)
  (given_m_value : m.val = 10)
  (given_mu_value : mu.val = ((1 : Real) / 20))
  (h_mi1_net_force_balance : T_heavy.val = M.val * g.val)
  (h_mi2_net_force_balance : T_light.val = m.val * g.val)
  (h_mi3_capstan_inequality : T_heavy.val / T_light.val <= Real.exp (mu.val * theta.val))
  (h_mi4_limiting_case : T_heavy.val / T_light.val = Real.exp (mu.val * theta.val))
  : False

theorem_decl:
theorem lean4phys_competition_mechanics_Ch2_Q1_c1_explicit_gap_allowed
  (M m : Mass)
  (T_heavy T_light : Force)
  (g : Acceleration)
  (n : Real)
  (mu : Dimensionless)
  (theta : PhysAngle)
  (given_M_value : M.val = 1000)
  (given_m_value : m.val = 10)
  (given_mu_value : mu.val = ((1 : Real) / 20))
  (h_if_heavy_bucket_force_balance : T_heavy.val = M.val * g.val)
  (h_if_light_bucket_force_balance : T_light.val = m.val * g.val)
  (h_if_capstan_inequality : T_heavy.val / T_light.val <= Real.exp (mu.val * theta.val))
  (h_if_capstan_limiting_case : T_heavy.val / T_light.val = Real.exp (mu.val * theta.val))
  (h_if_heavy_eq : T_heavy.val = M.val * g.val)
  (h_if_light_eq : T_light.val = m.val * g.val)
  (h_if_capstan_limit : T_heavy.val / T_light.val = Real.exp (mu.val * theta.val))
  : False

theorem lean4phys_competition_mechanics_Ch3_Q1_c1_explicit_gap_allowed
  (m1 m2 : Mass)

  (g : Acceleration)
  (x_eq_initial x_eq_final A : Length)
  (t : Time)
  (v_max : Speed)

  (h_mi1_equilibrium_balance : F_spring_initial.val = (m1.val + m2.val) * g.val)
  (h_mi2_hooke_final : F_spring_final.val = k.val * x_eq_final.val)
  (h_mi2_equilibrium_balance : F_spring_final.val = m1.val * g.val)

theorem_decl:
theorem archive_part1_archive_part1_2_3_c1_explicit_gap_allowed
  (F1 F2 P Fx Fy : Force)
  (beta theta gamma : PhysAngle)
  (given_beta_value : beta.val = 25)
  (given_theta_value : theta.val = 5)
  (given_F1_value : F1.val = 100)
  (given_P_value : P.val = 200)
  (h_mi1_force_balance_x : 0 = F1.val * Real.cos (beta.val + theta.val) + Fx.val)
  (h_mi1_force_balance_y : 0 = F1.val * Real.sin (beta.val + theta.val) + Fy.val - P.val)
  (h_mi1_aerodynamic_magnitude_angle : F2.val^2 = Fx.val^2 + Fy.val^2)
  (h_mi1_gamma_relation : Real.tan gamma.val = Fy.val / (-Fx.val))
  (h_mii2 : Fy.val = P.val - F1.val * Real.sin (beta.val + theta.val))
  : F2.val = Real.sqrt ((P.val - F1.val * Real.sin (beta.val + theta.val))^2 + (F1.val * Real.cos (beta.val + theta.val))^2) ∧
  Real.tan gamma.val = (P.val - F1.val * Real.sin (beta.val + theta.val)) / (F1.val * Real.cos (beta.val + theta.val))

theorem_decl:
theorem archive_part1_archive_part1_9_1_c1_explicit_gap_allowed
  (m : Mass)
  (F_s F_N Fnet_x Fnet_y : Force)
  (g a_c : Acceleration)
  (R : Length)
  (v_max v : Speed)
  (x y : Real)
  (f_s : Dimensionless)
  (theta : PhysAngle)
  (given_radius : R.val = 20)
  (given_tan_theta : Real.tan theta.val = ((1 : Real) / 2))
  (given_fs_value : f_s.val = ((1 : Real) / 4))
  (given_friction_bound : |F_s.val| <= f_s.val * F_N.val)
  (given_max_speed_limiting_friction : |F_s.val| = f_s.val * F_N.val)
  (given_vertical_acc_zero : Fnet_y.val = 0)
  (given_radial_acc_relation : a_c.val = v.val^2 / R.val)
  (given_radial_force_balance_form : Fnet_x.val = m.val * a_c.val)
  (max_speed_case_definition : v.val = v_max.val)
  (outward_slip_tendency_definition : F_s.val = f_s.val * F_N.val)
  (h_mi1_net_force_x : Fnet_x.val = F_N.val * Real.sin theta.val + F_s.val * Real.cos theta.val)
  (h_mi1_net_force_y : Fnet_y.val = F_N.val * Real.cos theta.val - F_s.val * Real.sin theta.val - m.val * g.val)
  (h_mi1_constraint_acceleration : a_c.val = v.val^2 / R.val)
  (h_mi1_sign_convention_friction : F_s.val = f_s.val * F_N.val)
  : Real.cos theta.val - f_s.val * Real.sin theta.val > 0 -> v_max.val = Real.sqrt (R.val * g.val * ((Real.sin theta.val + f_s.val * Real.cos theta.val) / (Real.cos theta.val - f_s.val * Real.sin theta.val)))
assumptions: Fnet_x.val = F_N.val * Real.sin theta.val + F_s.val * Real.cos theta.val
Fnet_y.val = F_N.val * Real.cos theta.val - F_s.val * Real.sin theta.val - m.val * g.val

theorem archive_part1_archive_part1_10_2_c1_explicit_gap_allowed
  (m : Mass)
  (F_r Fnet : Force)
  (g a : Acceleration)
  (h_before_open : Length)
  (t_after_open : Time)
  (v0 v_open v_after_5s : Speed)
  (given_mass : m.val = 60)
  (given_fall_distance_before_open : h_before_open.val = 100)
  (given_time_after_open : t_after_open.val = 5)
  (given_speed_after_5s : v_after_5s.val = ((43 : Real) / 10))
  (given_initial_rest : v0.val = 0)
  (def_post_open_acceleration : a.val = (v_after_5s.val - v_open.val) / t_after_open.val)
  (h_kinematics_pre_open_speed_distance : v_open.val * v_open.val = v0.val * v0.val + 2 * g.val * h_before_open.val)
  (h_net_force_post_open : Fnet.val = m.val * g.val - F_r.val)
  (h_newton2_post_open : Fnet.val = m.val * a.val)
  (h_kinematics_post_open_velocity_time : v_after_5s.val = v_open.val + a.val * t_after_open.val)

  (m_A m_B : Mass)

  (h_relative_shift_mi2 : s_rel.val = a.val - b.val)

  (h_mi_def2 : dx_B.val = x_Bf.val - x_Bi.val)

  (h_mi_def4 : s_rel.val = dx_B.val - dx_A.val)

theorem_decl:
theorem archive_part1_archive_part1_10_8_c1_explicit_gap_allowed
  (m_person m_boat : Mass)
  (P Q : Force)
  (g : Acceleration)
  (L delta_x_person delta_x_boat x_person_rel_boat x_boat : Length)
  (given_walk_direction : x_person_rel_boat.val = -L.val)
  (given_mass_weight_person : P.val = m_person.val * g.val)
  (given_mass_weight_boat : Q.val = m_boat.val * g.val)
  (h_com_balance_mi1 : m_person.val * delta_x_person.val + m_boat.val * delta_x_boat.val = 0)
  (h_relative_disp_mi2 : delta_x_person.val = delta_x_boat.val + x_person_rel_boat.val)
  (h_mass_weight_person_mi3 : P.val = m_person.val * g.val)
  (h_mass_weight_boat_mi3 : Q.val = m_boat.val * g.val)
  (h_mi2_expected_claim : delta_x_person.val = delta_x_boat.val + x_person_rel_boat.val)
  : x_boat.val = (P.val / (P.val + Q.val)) * L.val

theorem_decl:
theorem archive_part1_archive_part1_10_8_c1_explicit_gap_allowed
  (m_person m_boat : Mass)
  (P Q : Force)
  (g : Acceleration)
  (L delta_x_person delta_x_boat x_person_rel_boat x_boat : Length)
  (given_walk_direction : x_person_rel_boat.val = -L.val)
  (given_mass_weight_person : P.val = m_person.val * g.val)
  (given_mass_weight_boat : Q.val = m_boat.val * g.val)
  (h_com_balance_mi1 : m_person.val * delta_x_person.val + m_boat.val * delta_x_boat.val = 0)
  (h_relative_disp_mi2 : delta_x_person.val = delta_x_boat.val + x_person_rel_boat.val)
  (h_mass_weight_person_mi3 : P.val = m_person.val * g.val)
  (h_mass_weight_boat_mi3 : Q.val = m_boat.val * g.val)
  (h_mi1_gap : m_person.val * delta_x_person.val + m_boat.val * delta_x_boat.val = 0)
  (h_mi2_gap : delta_x_person.val = delta_x_boat.val + x_person_rel_boat.val)
  (h_mi2_expected_claim : delta_x_person.val = delta_x_boat.val + x_person_rel_boat.val)
  : x_boat.val = (P.val / (P.val + Q.val)) * L.val

  (m : Mass)

theorem_decl:
theorem archive_part1_archive_part1_11_23_c1_explicit_gap_allowed
  (m : Mass)
  (F_A0 F_B F_A delta_F_A : Force)
  (L d_A d_B : Length)
  (t : Time)
  (tau_net : Torque)
  (I_cm : MomentOfInertia)
  (alpha : AngularAcceleration)
  (theta theta_rad : PhysAngle)
  (given_mass : m.val = 100000)
  (given_length : L.val = 60)
  (given_engine_A_initial_thrust : F_A0.val = 2000000)
  (given_engine_B_thrust : F_B.val = 2000000)
  (given_time_interval : t.val = 1)
  (given_required_angle : theta.val = 1)
  (given_engine_A_offset : d_A.val = ((3 : Real) / 10))
  (given_engine_B_offset : d_B.val = ((3 : Real) / 10))
  (def_new_engine_A_thrust : F_A.val = F_A0.val + delta_F_A.val)
  (def_theta_rad_conversion : theta_rad.val = theta.val * Real.pi / 180)
  (h_global_equal_initial_thrusts : F_A0.val = F_B.val)
  (h_global_equal_offsets : d_A.val = d_B.val)
  (h_mi1_torque_balance : tau_net.val = I_cm.val * alpha.val)
  (h_mi1_rod_inertia : I_cm.val = ((1 : Real) / 12) * m.val * L.val^2)
  (h_mi2_signed_torque_sum : tau_net.val = F_A.val * d_A.val - F_B.val * d_B.val)
  (h_mi3_rotation_kinematics : theta_rad.val = ((1 : Real) / 2) * alpha.val * t.val^2)
  (h_mii1 : tau_net.val = F_A.val * d_A.val - F_B.val * d_B.val)
  (h_mii2 : F_A0.val = F_B.val)
  : delta_F_A.val = (((1 : Real) / 12) * m.val * L.val^2 * (2 * theta_rad.val / t.val^2)) / d_A.val

theorem_decl:
theorem archive_part1_archive_part1_11_23_c1_explicit_gap_allowed
  (m : Mass)
  (F_A0 F_B F_A delta_F_A : Force)
  (L d_A d_B : Length)
  (t : Time)
  (tau_net : Torque)
  (I_cm : MomentOfInertia)
  (alpha : AngularAcceleration)
  (theta theta_rad : PhysAngle)
  (given_mass : m.val = 100000)
  (given_length : L.val = 60)
  (given_engine_A_initial_thrust : F_A0.val = 2000000)
  (given_engine_B_thrust : F_B.val = 2000000)
  (given_time_interval : t.val = 1)
  (given_required_angle : theta.val = 1)
  (given_engine_A_offset : d_A.val = ((3 : Real) / 10))
  (given_engine_B_offset : d_B.val = ((3 : Real) / 10))
  (def_new_engine_A_thrust : F_A.val = F_A0.val + delta_F_A.val)
  (def_theta_rad_conversion : theta_rad.val = theta.val * Real.pi / 180)
  (h_global_equal_initial_thrusts : F_A0.val = F_B.val)
  (h_global_equal_offsets : d_A.val = d_B.val)
  (h_mi1_torque_balance : tau_net.val = I_cm.val * alpha.val)
  (h_mi1_rod_inertia : I_cm.val = ((1 : Real) / 12) * m.val * L.val^2)
  (h_mi2_signed_torque_sum : tau_net.val = F_A.val * d_A.val - F_B.val * d_B.val)
  (h_mi3_rotation_kinematics : theta_rad.val = ((1 : Real) / 2) * alpha.val * t.val^2)
  (h_mii1 : tau_net.val = F_A.val * d_A.val - F_B.val * d_B.val)
  (h_mii2 : F_A.val = F_A0.val + delta_F_A.val)
  : delta_F_A.val = (((1 : Real) / 12) * m.val * L.val^2 * (2 * theta_rad.val / t.val^2)) / d_A.val

  (h_mi1_arc_length : s.val = r.val * (phi_f.val - phi_i.val))
  (h_mi1_vertical_A : Delta_y_A.val = -(r.val * (phi_f.val - phi_i.val)))
  (h_mi1_vertical_B : Delta_y_B.val = r.val * (phi_f.val - phi_i.val))
  (h_mi3_gravity_work_A : W_gA.val = -(m_A.val * g.val * Delta_y_A.val))
  (h_mi3_gravity_work_B : W_gB.val = -(m_B.val * g.val * Delta_y_B.val))
  : W_total.val = 8 * pi^2 + (m_A.val - m_B.val) * g.val * r.val * (2 * pi)

theorem_decl:
theorem archive_part1_archive_part1_12_7_c1_explicit_gap_allowed
  (m_OA m_AB m_B : Mass)
  (P Q G : Force)
  (g : Acceleration)
  (r L : Length)
  (u v1 vB_i vB_f : Speed)
  (M : Torque)
  (I_OA_O I_AB_Gc : MomentOfInertia)
  (omega_i omega_f : AngularVelocity)
  (T_i T_f W_M : Energy)
  (s : Real)
  (theta_i theta_f : PhysAngle)
  (def_mass_crank : m_OA.val = P.val / g.val)
  (def_mass_connecting_rod : m_AB.val = Q.val / g.val)
  (def_mass_slider : m_B.val = G.val / g.val)
  (def_crank_inertia_about_O : I_OA_O.val = (1 / 3) * m_OA.val * r.val^2)
  (def_connecting_rod_centroidal_inertia : I_AB_Gc.val = (1 / 12) * m_AB.val * L.val^2)
  (h_global_sign_convention_work : W_M.val = M.val * (Real.pi / 2))
  (h_mi1_speed_A_initial : u.val = omega_i.val * r.val)
  (h_mi1_speed_A_final : v1.val = omega_f.val * r.val)
  (h_mi2_initial_slider_speed : vB_i.val = u.val)
  (h_mi3_final_slider_speed : vB_f.val = 0)

  (m_crank m_rod m_slider : Mass)

  (given_crank_weight : P.val > 0)

  (given_crank_length : r.val > 0)

theorem archive_part1_archive_part1_13_3_c1_explicit_gap_allowed
  (m1 m2 m3 m3_max : Mass)
  (T F_friction : Force)
  (a a_at_m3_max g : Acceleration)
  (block_width_horizontal block_height base_half_width height_half : Length)
  (given_m1_value : m1.val = 100)

  (def_base_half_width : base_half_width.val = block_width_horizontal.val / 2)
  (def_height_half : height_half.val = block_height.val / 2)
  (h_mi1_net_force_block : F_friction.val = m1.val * a.val)
  (h_mi2_net_force_cart_block : T.val = (m1.val + m2.val) * a.val)
  (h_mi3_net_force_hanging : m3.val * g.val - T.val = m3.val * a.val)
  (h_mi4_tipping_geometry : a.val / g.val = base_half_width.val / height_half.val)
  : m3_max.val = m1.val + m2.val ∧
  a_at_m3_max.val = g.val / 2

theorem archive_part1_archive_part1_13_3_c1_explicit_gap_allowed
  (m1 m2 m3 m3_max : Mass)
  (T F_friction : Force)
  (a a_at_m3_max g : Acceleration)
  (block_width_horizontal block_height base_half_width height_half : Length)
  (given_m1_value : m1.val = 100)
  (given_m2_value : m2.val = 50)
  (given_block_width : block_width_horizontal.val = ((1 : Real) / 2))
  (given_block_height : block_height.val = (1 : Real))
  (def_base_half_width : base_half_width.val = block_width_horizontal.val / 2)
  (def_height_half : height_half.val = block_height.val / 2)
  (h_mi1_net_force_block : F_friction.val = m1.val * a.val)
  (h_mi2_net_force_cart_block : T.val = (m1.val + m2.val) * a.val)
  (h_mi3_net_force_hanging : m3.val * g.val - T.val = m3.val * a.val)
  (h_mi4_tipping_geometry : a.val / g.val = base_half_width.val / height_half.val)
  (h_mi4_base_half_width_local_model : base_half_width.val = block_width_horizontal.val / 2)
  (h_mi4_height_half_local_model : height_half.val = block_height.val / 2)
  : m3_max.val = m1.val + m2.val ∧
  a_at_m3_max.val = g.val / 2
